import ctypes, os, random, zlib, sys

lib = ctypes.CDLL('/app/libcompress.so')
lib.compressBound.restype = ctypes.c_int
lib.compressBound.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int]
lib.compress.restype = ctypes.c_int
lib.compress.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]
lib.decompress.restype = ctypes.c_int
lib.decompress.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]

def roundtrip(data, name):
    n = len(data)
    bound = lib.compressBound(n)
    assert bound > 0, (name, bound)
    cbuf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bound)
    csize = lib.compress(data, ctypes.byref(cbuf), n)
    assert csize > 0, (name, csize)
    assert csize <= bound, (name, csize, bound)
    out = ctypes.create_string_buffer(n + 16)
    dsize = lib.decompress(cbuf.raw[:csize], ctypes.byref(out), csize)
    assert dsize == n, (name, dsize, n)
    assert out.raw[:n] == data, (name, 'data mismatch')
    print(f'OK {name}: {n} -> {csize}')

roundtrip(b'', 'empty')
roundtrip(b'a', 'one')
roundtrip(b'ab', 'two')
roundtrip(b'abc', 'three')
roundtrip(b'abcd', 'four')
roundtrip(b'aaaa', 'four-same')
roundtrip(bytes(range(256)), 'all-bytes')
roundtrip(b'hello world, hello world, hello world!', 'hello')
for L in [5, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 30, 100, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256, 1000]:
    roundtrip(b'A' * L, f'Ax{L}')
    roundtrip(bytes(range(L % 251)) if L <= 251 else os.urandom(L), f'seq/rand{L}')
    roundtrip(os.urandom(L), f'random{L}')
roundtrip(b'A' * 100000, 'A x 100k')
roundtrip((b'abcdefgh' * 20000), 'pattern 160k')
roundtrip(os.urandom(1000000), 'random 1MB')
big = (b'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. ' * 5000) + os.urandom(70000) + (b'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. ' * 5000)
roundtrip(big, 'mixed >64k window')
roundtrip(b'\x00' * 50000, 'zeros 50k')
roundtrip(bytes([random.randrange(4) for _ in range(200000)]), 'low-entropy 200k')
# long-range match beyond 65535 apart (should still work: just not matched)
chunk = os.urandom(1000)
roundtrip(chunk + os.urandom(70000) + chunk, 'repeated chunk far apart')
# exactly window-distance match
chunk = os.urandom(100)
roundtrip(chunk + os.urandom(65435) + chunk, 'match at 65535')
print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
EOF
